answer: Think of Ambient-light reading at answer time as a toll booth: the light level where the agent sits, matched to its history, so the mirror of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Honest agents already carry what Ambient-light reading at answer time asks for, so they pass without noticing; the haven is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the beacon is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
